meta.name: hexagonal-architecture
meta.description: Applies hexagonal (ports & adapters) architecture. Use when designing application structure, separating domain from infrastructure, creating testable boundaries, or when user mentions ports, adapters, hexagonal, or clean architecture.

copy.tagline: 分离领域与技术基础设施，构建可测试边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在设计应用结构时想隔离领域和基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Separate domain from infrastructure to build testable boundaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to structure applications using ports and adapters

howto.what: Claude会按照六边形架构原则指导你设计应用程序，帮你区分领域逻辑（六边形内部）与基础设施（外部适配器），定义端口和适配器，并提醒避免常见反模式。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计应用程序结构”“分离领域与基础设施”或提及ports、adapters、hexagonal等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用六边形架构设计一个用户注册模块。
say.note: Claude会生成领域、应用服务和适配器结构。

say.text: 领域层应该包含哪些类？
say.note: Claude会解释实体、值对象和领域服务。

say.text: 如何避免贫血领域模型？
say.note: Claude会建议把业务逻辑放入实体中。

howto.what_en: Claude applies hexagonal architecture principles to help you design applications: it distinguishes domain logic (inside the hexagon) from infrastructure (outside adapters), defines ports and adapters, and warns against common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: When you mention designing application structure, separating domain from infrastructure, or say ports, adapters, hexagonal, clean architecture, etc.

say_en.text: Design a user registration module using hexagonal architecture.
say_en.note: Claude will produce domain, application service, and adapter structures.

say_en.text: What classes go in the domain layer?
say_en.note: Claude explains entities, value objects, and domain services.

say_en.text: How to avoid anemic domain model?
say_en.note: Claude suggests putting business logic into entities.
